title: Category 1 — Toxic Chemicals & Precursors
text: Export of radioactive elements and isotopes (HS 284440) requires prior authorization and end-user certificate (EUC) under DGFT Appendix 3 SCOMET regulations.

title: Category 3 — Nuclear Equipment & Dual-Use Materials
text: Nuclear reactors and fuel elements (HS 840110) are classified under SCOMET Dual-Use Schedule 3. Exporters must submit inter-ministerial screening dossiers.

title: Category 4 — Specialized Electronics & Telecoms
text: High-frequency signal generators and specialized crypto hardware (HS 854370) require SCOMET Category 4 export license.

title: India-UAE Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA)
text: The India-UAE CEPA entered into force on 1 May 2022. It eliminates tariffs on 90% of Indian exports to UAE including gems, textiles, agriculture, and engineering goods.

title: India-Australia Economic Cooperation and Trade Agreement (ECTA)
text: India-Australia ECTA entered into force on 29 December 2022. Australia offers zero duty on 100% of tariff lines for Indian exports with stringent rules of origin.

title: India-Japan Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement
text: India-Japan CEPA eliminates tariffs on over 94% of bilateral trade lines over a 10-year transition period.

title: India-Singapore Comprehensive Economic Cooperation Agreement (CECA)
text: Signed in 2005, India-Singapore CECA established preferential trade schedules, digital logistics facilitation, and financial services integration.

title: Port of Nhava Sheva (Jawaharlal Nehru Port)
text: UN/LOCODE INBOM is India's largest container seaport, handling over 50% of containerized cross-border cargo with direct multimodal rail ICD links.

title: Port of Chennai
text: UN/LOCODE INMAA is a major East Coast container and automotive logistics gateway with dedicated container terminals.

title: Port of Jebel Ali / Dubai
text: UN/LOCODE AEDXB is the premier transshipment port and logistics free zone in the Middle East facilitating India-GCC trade.

title: Port of Singapore
text: UN/LOCODE SGSIN is the global mega-hub transshipment port connecting Asia-Pacific corridors with automated container logistics.
